title: How We Get Along
grammar: Reciprocal egymás; kijönnek egymással for describing how well people get along
goal: I can say what people do to or with each other using egymás.
I can say how well people get along using kijönnek egymással.
I can use four new words for talking about relationships in general.
I can describe a relationship's basic dynamic in a few sentences.
